# Ergon Labs

> Ergon Labs is an AI engineering firm: an AI and engineering partner for scale-ups and enterprise products. Lead engineers and AI researchers with experience across US and European companies, building agents, custom models and the systems around them.

We work as a senior extension of a client's team, designing, building and running AI in production. Every engagement starts with a free call and a written quote. Clients own the code, cloud and IP from the first commit, and see a working demo every week.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ergonlabs.studio/): services, process, engagement models, principles and FAQ
- [Founders](https://www.ergonlabs.studio/founders): Muhammad Rizwan (co-founder, engineering) and Talha Asif (co-founder, AI research)
- [Free AI audit](https://www.ergonlabs.studio/audit): send a product, repository or AI feature and a senior engineer shows what to fix, for free
- [Start a project](https://www.ergonlabs.studio/intro): project enquiry form; an engineer replies within one working day
- [Careers](https://www.ergonlabs.studio/careers): we work only with senior engineers and AI researchers

## Services

- AI and agents: agents, assistants and LLM features (RAG, voice AI, automation, evals, MCP), tested against real cases before anyone relies on them
- Custom models and data: training, fine-tuning and serving models, plus the data pipelines underneath (PyTorch, vision, forecasting, vector databases, MLOps)
- Product UI/UX: research, flows and designs for web, mobile and AI products
- Full-stack product engineering: web apps, mobile apps, backends and APIs (Next.js, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL)
- Cloud, DevOps and security: infrastructure as code, automated deployments, monitoring and security reviews (AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes)
- Rescue, audits and advice: stabilising fast-built and legacy systems, code and architecture audits, fractional CTO

## Ways to work together

- Sprint: a prototype, an MVP, an AI proof of concept (fixed price)
- Build: a whole product
- Embed: senior engineers joining a team that is short of senior people (billed monthly)
- Advise: a decision you only get to make once
